review.reason: Integrated B2+B4 additive, read-only endpoints: GET /api/data/quality (NAV-series/profile quality summary; DataQualityReport/DataQualityIssue) and GET /api/data/sources/health (upstream reachability/latency probe; DataSourceHealthReport/EndpointHealth). Diff vs pre-feature baseline 7d34065 adds exactly 2 operations and 6 schemas with zero breaking hints; no existing operation, field, constraint, response code, or required parameter changed.
